author: New China TV
description:
Just two hours from Chongqing - a city where summer heat can hit over 40 degrees Celsius - lies Huangshui Town, where temperatures stay at around 24 degrees Celsius at the hottest time of the year.
But this mountain escape isn't just about cooler air. It's transforming the climate edge into a thriving summer economy, with electric boats cruising across the lake, paddleboarding adventures, floating BBQ boats, and even mahjong tables set right on the boat.
Join Xinhua's Yu Xiaosu as she explores one of the coolest corners of one of China's hottest cities. (recorded)
title: How mountain town in SW China is turning cool weather into summer business boom
